stories.title: Anthropic's IPO & Nvidia Drama Test Investor AI Appetite
stories.take: Anthropic's record IPO turned muted on day two, down about 12.5% toward its $83 IPO price with staff locked up for 180 days • Hosts compare it to Facebook's IPO train wreck and recovery, but note Anthropic is less proven with more rivals and regulation • S&P 500 is in correction, down 10% from its high, as the AI trade unwinds

stories.title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
stories.take: The answer: legally yes — founders hold 50.1% of voting power, so shareholders can't vote safety out — but economically the pressure points the other way • Anthropic must grow revenue roughly 17-fold in 10 years while paying about $900B in compute costs, and expensive safety work is the likeliest casualty • Watch earnings calls for quietly sidelined safety teams, not the daily stock price

stories.title: Man found guilty of starting deadly LA wildfire
stories.take: A jury found Jonathan Rinderknecht guilty of starting the deadly 2025 Palisades fire; he faces 5–20 years per count, sentencing March 17 • Prosecutors said a small New Year's Day fire smouldered in roots for six days before winds revived it; the fires killed 12 and destroyed thousands of homes • Trump defended Putin and Xi meetings and threatened to ban US firms building AI data centers overseas

stories.title: The Happy Pod: The 'amazing’ device that controls Tourette's
stories.take: A UK-trialled wrist device sending pulses to the median nerve eased Tourette's tics for 17-year-old Milo — his mother says his face visibly relaxes when he wears it • A Gifu chef who was once homeless runs Seven Cafe: free meals for preschoolers, cheap buffets, and about 50 volunteers, taking no salary • Voyager 1 became the first human-made object one light-day from Earth, more than 25 billion km away

stories.title: How AI Is Forcing China to Reshape Industrial Policy
stories.take: The answer: Beijing is pushing firms toward a fully self-reliant chip stack — co-designing with Huawei even at short-term cost — over building on the best Nvidia chips today • US export controls and five-year-plan incentives drive the full-stack push across chips, HBM, and lithography • Huawei Ascend chips are good enough for inference and pushing toward training; the bottleneck is production scale at SMIC

stories.title: Jensen Huang's Downfall Reveals Silicon Valley's Biggest Problem
stories.take: The answer: Silicon Valley's biggest problem is billionaire CEOs who are never told no — the 'Icarus Paradox,' where flattery inflates judgment until it fails • For Huang, Elson points to allegedly circumventing export laws or not seeing an alleged Chinese chip smuggler as a problem • Nvidia had no board chair, COO, or succession plan, Elson notes

stories.title: Hakeem Jeffries on Trump, Stephen Miller, AIPAC and the Road Ahead
stories.take: House Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker, putting him in line to be the first Black Speaker on Jan. 3 • Jeffries says he won't deal with Stephen Miller, whom he calls a 'stone cold racist,' but can talk directly to Trump and cabinet secretaries • His affordability targets: housing, health care, gas, utilities, groceries, and caregiving

stories.title: Democrats audition for 2028

Raphael Warnock: voters didn't fall in love with Democrats, they felt crushed economically and gave the party a chance — it must center people, not politics • Warnock says the party ignores the South at its peril and should dream bigger on health care

stories.title: AI Stocks Tumble, Permitting Reform Bill Clears Senate, Confusion Over Medicaid Cuts
stories.take: NASDAQ fell 10% this week, its worst since 2020, with the S&P and Dow in correction despite Anthropic's record IPO • Drivers cited: a September Fed rate hike, Democrats promising to slow the AI boom, and Jensen Huang's resignation • The Senate passed bipartisan permitting reform rewriting NEPA and other laws, while confusion grows over Medicaid cuts

stories.title: What’s News in Markets: Anthropic IPO, Nvidia Drama, ‘GTA VI’
stories.take: Markets in correction: NASDAQ -8% for the week, S&P nearly -9%, Dow -10%, erasing NASDAQ's 2026 gains • Anthropic popped 30% at its IPO open but finished day one up just 17%, then fell 8.5% Friday to just under $89 vs. its $83 IPO price • Nvidia is down 23% for the week and now the fourth-largest US company; GTA VI is projected to sell 30M+ copies at $80+
